# Goshen International Business School (GIBS)

> An outfit committed to manpower development and capacity-building. Our uniqueness is in this dedication.

## Institutional Metadata & Governance
- Legal Name: Goshen International Business School Limited (GIBS)
- Short Name: GIBS
- CAC Registration: RC 1178333
- Slogan: Take advantage of us, so that no one takes advantage of you
- Website: https://gibs.com.ng
- Postal Address: P.O. Box 63, Ilorin General Post Office, Kwara State, Nigeria
- Primary Phone Numbers: 08160010401, 08186464474, 07085792767, 08160010400
- Email: gibsilorin@gmail.com, goshenibs22@gmail.com
- Technical Partner: Pacific Institute of Technology, Georgia, United States of America.
- Accreditations: Corporate Affairs Commission (CAC RC 1178333), Centre For Management Development (CMD), Industrial Training Fund (ITF) Certificate of Compliance, Nigeria Social Insurance Trust Fund (NSTIF)
- Overseas Executive Hubs: Houston (USA), London (UK), Dubai (UAE), Kigali (Rwanda)
- Domestic Training Centres: Ilorin, Abuja, Lagos, Ibafo

## 2026 Training Programme Catalogue
- Total Canonical Programmes: 135
- Local Open Programmes: 113 programmes (5-day intensive onsite courses in Ilorin, Abuja, Lagos, Ibafo)
- Foreign Executive Programmes: 22 programmes (Kigali, Dubai, London, Houston)
- Local Tuition Fees: ₦300,000 to ₦800,000 NGN
- Foreign Tuition Fees: $4,800 USD to $9,500 USD / £4,800 GBP

## Programme Content & Curriculum Architecture
- Canonical 2026 Catalogue: 135 programmes across 15 industry categories
- Category introductions with topic-specific curricula: 15 of 15 categories approved (0 pending institutional verification)
- Supplementary content layer: 10 per-programme records (0 approved, 10 pending verification) and 15 category-page introductions (15 approved, 0 pending verification)
- Verified catalogue metadata: Every programme specifies official course code, category, destination, duration, 2026 calendar sessions, tuition fee, and target executive audience
- Quality gate policy: Unverified claims are strictly barred; pages render verified catalogue values and approved syllabus content only
